title: Rural-calibrated febrile infant decision support tool — analysis code (retired)
description: RETIRED (June 2026). Analysis code for a derivation study that was rejected after peer review and is no longer being pursued. Peer review established that the prediction model does not outperform existing validated febrile-infant decision rules (internally-validated AUC 0.780, below PECARN and Step-by-Step), that the meta-analysis was underpowered and not a valid pooled meta-analysis (pooled estimates rested on as few as two cohorts, with cohort overlap and heterogeneous age ranges), and that the planned conformal-prediction method returned a null result at the observed invasive-bacterial-infection prevalence; the development cohort was affected by selection bias. This release is retained solely as a reproducible record of a negative result and must not inform patient care. For clinical use, rely on the established externally-validated rules: PECARN, Step-by-Step, Aronson, and the 2021 AAP clinical practice guideline.
